lines.trans: Well what, do you want to fire me now?
On the contrary, I want to promote you big time today.
You were head chef of the restaurant, and now you will be the owner.
Wait, sit down, I did not understand you at all.
What is unclear here, marry me, Vitya!

lines.trans: I understood everything, you still love me.
You even specially called Nagiyev here for my sake.
Vitya, that is the exact kind of husband I need!
Elya, wait, you do not mean this seriously right now, do you?
Admit to yourself that you love me, and everything will work out.
Elya, stop, I have loved another woman for a long time!

examples.text: А от меня ты сейчас чего хочешь?
examples.trans: And what do you want from me right now?

examples.text: Конечно мне, ведь у меня сейчас кризис.
examples.trans: For me of course, because I am having a crisis right now.

examples.text: Вы думаете, мне это действительно сейчас поможет?
examples.trans: Do you think this will really help me right now?

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'серьёзно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Эля, постой, ты ведь это сейчас несерьёзно?
examples.trans: Elya, wait, you do not mean this seriously right now, do you?

examples.text: Костя сказал это совершенно несерьёзно и спокойно.
examples.trans: Kostya said this quite not seriously and calmly.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'знаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'admit', paired with 'признаваться'.

examples.text: Ну что, признался?
examples.trans: Well, did he confess?

examples.text: Он во всём признался.
examples.trans: He confessed to everything.

examples.text: Никак, я тебя на понт взяла. А ты сейчас сама призналась.
examples.trans: No way at all, I called your bluff. And you just confessed yourself.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to oneself', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Скажи, она сейчас у себя в кабинете?
examples.trans: Tell me, is she in her office right now?

examples.text: А Денис пусть себе думает, что хочет.
examples.trans: And let Denis think whatever he wants.

examples.text: Признайся себе, что ты меня любишь, и всё получится.
examples.trans: Admit to yourself that you love me, and everything will work out.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'and', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Скажи, чего ты так радостно улыбаешься?
examples.trans: Tell me, why are you smiling so cheerfully?

examples.text: Вы обе с этой минуты уволены!
examples.trans: You are both fired as of this minute!

examples.text: Виктор, она уволила семь горничных за три дня.
examples.trans: Viktor, she fired seven maids in three days.

meanings.en: to turn out, to work out
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'лучиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will work out', paired with 'получаться'.

examples.text: Всё получится!
examples.trans: It will all work out!

examples.text: Из него получится хороший врач.
examples.trans: He'll make a good doctor.

examples.text: Классный из тебя мэр получится, Самсон.
examples.trans: You'll make a great mayor, Samson.

остановиться.gloss: to stop, to come to a halt

meanings.en: to stop, to pause, to come to a halt
meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to stop, to come to a halt', paired with 'останавливаться'.

examples.text: Он только начал бояться, а ты остановился!
examples.trans: He just started getting scared, and you stopped!

examples.text: Остановилась там кровь уже?
examples.trans: Has the bleeding stopped yet?

examples.text: Ваня, ты что? Он только начал бояться, а ты остановился!
examples.trans: Vanya, what is wrong with you? He just started getting scared, and you stopped!

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Давайте решайтесь уже быстрее!
examples.trans: Come on, decide faster already!

examples.text: Раз ты такой заботливый, давай выпьем за здоровье.
examples.trans: Since you are so caring, let us drink to my health.

examples.text: Ну что ты говоришь, давай выпьем за тебя.
examples.trans: What are you saying, let us drink to you.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('another').

examples.text: Вот и иди дальше к своей подруге.
examples.trans: Then keep going to your friend.

examples.text: Например, прийти на день рождения с другой девушкой.
examples.trans: For example, come to the birthday party with another girl.

examples.text: Эля, остановись, я давно люблю другую женщину!
examples.trans: Elya, stop, I have loved another woman for a long time!

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'woman' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Товарищ командир, отпустите, пожалуйста, вот тех двух женщин.
examples.trans: Comrade commander, please release those two women over there.

examples.text: Скажите, а вторая женщина тоже ваша девушка?
examples.trans: Tell me, is the second woman also your girlfriend?

examples.text: Эля, остановись, я давно люблю другую женщину!
examples.trans: Elya, stop, I have loved another woman for a long time!

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'стить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'forgive', paired with 'прощать'.

examples.text: Попробуйте спокойно понять и простить своего мужа.
examples.trans: Try to calmly understand and forgive your husband.

examples.text: Здравствуй, Витя, как думаешь, простит меня жена?
examples.trans: Hello, Vitya, what do you think, will my wife forgive me?

examples.text: Прости меня, я не хотел тебе сделать больно.
examples.trans: Forgive me, I did not want to hurt you.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'делать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'делать'.

examples.text: Прости меня, я не хотел тебе сделать больно.
examples.trans: Forgive me, I did not want to hurt you.

examples.text: Мы сделали много.
examples.trans: We've done a lot.

examples.text: Я сделаю это завтра.
examples.trans: I'll do it tomorrow.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Есть одна хорошая больница, точнее тихий санаторий.
examples.trans: There is one good hospital, or rather a quiet sanatorium.

examples.text: Скажите, а большой бассейн там у них есть?
examples.trans: Tell me, do they have a large swimming pool there?

examples.text: Нормально, я в больнице, а он тут торт ест!
examples.trans: Nice, I am in the hospital, and he is here eating cake!

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'хотеть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning '(you) wanted', paired with 'хотеть'.

examples.text: Ты не хотел, а я вот теперь захотела!
examples.trans: You did not want to, well now I want to!

examples.text: У вас будет всё, что захотите.
examples.trans: You'll have everything you want.

examples.text: Если захочешь, позвони.
examples.trans: If you want, call me.
